question: He tossed the coin into the ______
solution:
The correct answer is '**well**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
 
 
• The word "**well**" refers to a structure used to access water and is contextually correct in this sentence. 
 
• The sentence implies that the coin was tossed into a specific structure, and "**well**" fits the meaning.
